`mp_box.CM_BRUSHES[19]` is one of these walls on the "VDU" boxes (where faction leaders livestream to the troops)

Checking which axial sides are discarded, we can see that this brush is actually one of the 4 northern/southern walls
```python
>>> vec3 = bsp_tool.branches.vector.vec3
>>> axes = {vec3(x=1): "X+", vec3(x=-1): "X-", vec3(y=1): "Y+", vec3(y=-1): "Y-", vec3(z=1): "Z+", vec3(z=-1): "Z-"}
>>> {print(axes[pl[0]], pr) for pl, pr in [*zip(b19["planes"], b19["properties"])][:6]}
X+ BrushSideProperty.DISCARD|1
X- BrushSideProperty.DISCARD|1
Y+ BrushSideProperty.2|1
Y- BrushSideProperty.1
Z+ BrushSideProperty.UNKNOWN_FLAG|1
Z- BrushSideProperty.UNKNOWN_FLAG|1
{None}
```

The way `BrushSideProperty.UNKNOWN_FLAG` appears here makes me think it's used on faces that abut other brushes
(and would never be touched / seen)
Ignoring physics on these sides could limit "pixel walking"

Pixel walking occurs when a rounding error allows a player to stand on the unexposed of a brush, whilst against a wall

```
  P|__ SOLID WALL
 __|   ^ ABUTTING BRUSHSIDE
 ```

`Brush[19]` was selected w/ the following filter for non-axial brushes:

>`(34, 1, 1)`
No masks on the non-axial planes here? is `unknown_non_axial` counting non-discarded non-axial sides?, or discarded axial sides?
We need to find a brush with non-ambiguous counts, and assert those counts are consistent across all brushes

Time to test.

`r2_rise` passes the test!
```python
>>> r1 = bsp_tool.branches.respawn.titanfall
>>> def test(bsp, brush_index: int) -> bool:
...     brush_sides = bsp.get_brush_sides(brush_index)
...     brush = bsp.CM_BRUSHES[brush_index]
...     return brush.unknown_non_axial == len([p for p in brush_sides["properties"][6:]
                                               if (p & r1.BrushSideProperty.DISCARD) == 0])
...
>>> test(r2_rise, 774)
True
>>> all([test(r2_rise, i) for i, u, npo in bis])
True  # !!!
```

Now to test all `r1`, `r1o` & `r2` maps

```python
>>> import os, fnmatch
>>> r1md = "E:/Mod/Titanfall/maps"
>>> r1omd = "E:/Mod/TitanfallOnline/maps"
>>> r2md = "E:/Mod/Titanfall2/maps"
>>> gd = {"r1": r1md, "r1o": r1omd, "r2": r2md}
>>> maps = {f"{g}/{m[:-4]}": bsp_tool.load_bsp(os.path.join(md, m))
            for g, md in gd.items() for m in fnmatch.filter(os.listdir(md), "*.bsp")}
>>> {m for m, b in maps.items() if any([test(b, i) == False for i in range(len(b.CM_BRUSHES))])}
set()  # all maps pass the test!
```
